description: Returns a page of issue types in a project using a given status.

parameters.description: The statusId to fetch issue type usages for
parameters.name: statusId

parameters.description: The projectId to fetch issue type usages for
parameters.name: projectId

parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return. Must be an integer between 1 and 200.
parameters.name: maxResults

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing, or the caller doesn't have permissions to perform the operation.

404.description: Returned if the status with the given ID does not exist.

summary: Get issue type usages by status and project
